bindingInstructions.required: Root launcher must write a bound copy outside checkout with actual clean candidate sourceCommit/tree and exact hashes. Never replace literal expected outputs with product-derived values. UNBOUND index hash intentionally refuses driver validation.

execution.mutationInvocation: Existing driver reports intended mutant assertions as FAIL/exit1. Launcher selects each mutant independently and requires expectedFailureContains plus real rendered snapshots; never accept generic exit1. Include healthyControlCaseIds.
execution.firstFrameConstraint: firstPredicate binds actual current civil day/timetableDate and required admitted next day only, never expected target key/time. All-render raw traces + video/crops must independently establish actual first presented eligible frame; still ordinal mismatch remains explicit.
execution.recoveryConstraint: Actual held prefetch body is released only after authored optional-font LINK load/error terminality, media activation on load, read-only native layout, actual FontFaceSet.ready, typed per-face loadingdone/loadingerror receipts deferred until dispatch returns, zero pending observer receipts and the existing clear dirty flag. The R0007-only pre-document observer is bound to static authored font startup; missing receipts and observed lifecycle changes fail diagnostically. No product render/clock/target wait or replacement scheduler is added. The250ms actual scheduling observation is eventual; independent all-render/video review still owns earliest eligible/visible recovery.
execution.durationGuidance: Functional recipes add at most one250ms scheduling observation; old loading recipes retain250ms loading hold; no deliberate10s request deadline or60s cooldown replay. Browser/bootstrap/font readiness costs are host-dependent. Each conditional motion recipe retains its original30s watch and60s warm bound. Run engines and cases serially; do not repeatedly replay accepted subsets without a changed risk.
